translations.web: I took my staff Favor, and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
translations.bsb: Next I took my staff called Favor and cut it in two, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
translations.kjv: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
